assertions.name: c6_c7_applied_forms_recovered_by_bias_correction
assertions.source: The bias-corrected extraction recovers the c_6=4·b² and c_7=-8 forms that the extraction IMPOSES (self-consistency of the bias-correction method; NOT an independent validation).

assertions.name: pell_lucas_pattern_survives_into_free_rungs_c8plus
assertions.source: Whether the Pell-Lucas closed forms reproduce the bias-corrected FREE-rung extraction (c_8,c_9,c_10 — not imposed by the extraction) within 1%. Expected False: c_8 corrected ≈ -0.215 vs predicted 4·b⁴ ≈ +2.27 (wrong sign) — the pattern breaks at the first free rung. The forms are silver-ratio structural identities, not q₀ production coefficients.

assertions.name: c6_c10_closed_forms_anchor_stable_swing_under_1pct
assertions.source: The real-q closed forms swing <1% between proton and muon anchors (b²(q) smooth). Necessary but not sufficient for canonical.

data.verdict: EMPIRICAL — SILVER-ANCHORED. Against PR #1824's bias-corrected q₀ extraction: the c_6/c_7 forms (which the extraction IMPOSES) are recovered (self-consistency, 0.0052%/0.26%), but the Pell-Lucas pattern BREAKS at the first FREE rung c_8 (closed 2.266 vs corrected -0.215). The forms are anchor-stable (swing 5.82e-11% < 1%) and EXACT only at the silver structural anchor; they are not q₀ production coefficients. Stays empirical — silver-anchored, no production wire (§8). Falsification test; no fit, no production change.
